messages:
Nina: quick postmortem follow-up from last night's GPU surge. need owners for headroom plan, scheduler tuning, tenant quotas, and a recurring audit. keep replies short.
Carlos: i'll take scheduler tuning. short-term: slot-cap bump for small-model traffic (8->11) behind feature flag. PR ETA 2025-06-14.
Teo: i'll own tenant quota backstops. plan: per-tenant token-bucket + emergency throttle and alerts. PR ETA 2025-06-12.
Nina: i'll draft headroom targets per-cluster + routing rules to Dedicated pools. include cost estimate. due 2025-06-16.
sre-bot: incident digest: 2025-06-04 02:08 UTC surge -> scheduler queue growth and headroom starvation. peak GPU util 98.7%, fallback rate 25%.
Carlos: canary plan: 5% traffic for 2h; monitor gpu_utilization, scheduler_queue_len, preemption_rate, fallback_rate. quick smoke: 10m at 80% sustained.
Teo: quota sketch:
```yaml
per_tenant:
  burst_tokens: 360
  refill_per_sec: 36
  max_concurrent: 160
alerts:
  sustained_pct: 70
```
Nina: recurring pattern: headroom erosion ~21 days tied to batch-job windows. opsbot, create weekly headroom audit task.
opsbot: created task #CI-6001 "weekly-headroom-audit" assigned ops-rotation; first run 2025-06-18.
Carlos: opened draft PR for slot-cap: https://git.internal/r/5120 - requesting review from @Teo @Nina
Teo: will open token-bucket PR today and enable alerts 24h after merge.
Nina: owners recap + due dates: Carlos - scheduler PR & canary (2025-06-14); Teo - quota PR & alerts (2025-06-12); Nina - headroom + routing proposal (2025-06-16).
Carlos: after merges we'll run 2h canary verification and 6h soak for full rollout.
Nina: i'll add milestone cards and link to the postmortem doc. closing thread for now, reopen if blockers. :thumbsup:
